issues.existing: small lanterns hanging on the posts
issues.observed: lit lanterns standing on the platform floor, not hanging from the posts
issues.evidence: Three lanterns are individually resolvable and all sit at ground level on the stone platform: one at the lower left beside the near post's base, one at the centre beside the food spread, and one at the right on the platform near the right post's base. Each throws light downward onto the platform and casts a reflection in the wet surface beneath it. Nothing is suspended from any post; the small glows higher up are points of light within the strung garland, not lanterns on the posts.

issues.observed: a large ringed orb at the upper right plus at least three other separate rounded bodies elsewhere in the sky (a grey cratered disc at upper left, a small disc near the right edge, a faint disc at mid-right)
issues.evidence: The other spheres are scattered across opposite corners of the sky rather than arranged around the ringed orb; no orbital relationship between them is visible, and the total number of bodies cannot be fixed because several faint discs may be nebula texture.

uncertainObservations: The number of celestial spheres cannot be stated: at least four rounded bodies are visible (upper left, upper right large ringed one, one near the right edge, one faint at mid-right), but several fainter discs may be nebula texture rather than bodies.
The lantern count cannot be fixed; three are clearly individually resolvable on the platform but additional warm points may be lanterns, candles or reflections.
What the second figure's extended hand holds or reaches for is ambiguous — there is a small glow between her hand and the third figure.
The head ornament on the third figure reads as a small crown or tiara but could be a flower wreath.
The items on the carried tray are small and rounded; identifying them as fruit is at the edge of resolution.
Whether the figures are stationary or mid-stride is not determinable.
